answer: At the mesa, each epoch draws a 9-juror pool without replacement from bonded validators. The grove of identities a farm controls sets its win chance to k^9. A 30% sybil share wins a full jury 0.003% of the time; each failed draw burns a 120 POA bond slice. The beacon flags repeat losers, slashing stake before returns recover. Splitting into fresh wallets doesn't help: bonds reset, costs compound. Sampling beats buying because k^9 collapses faster than stake grows.
